dialog.dexrider.nine.lost.1: This world... the blocks, the square sun... where am I? I have to find the signal from Kagami-kun's Driver.
dialog.dexrider.nine.lost.2: Calm down, Nine. Think: if the Driver's signal reached this far, Kagami-kun must be close.
dialog.dexrider.nine.spot_dex.1: That's Kagami-kun's Driver! ...But I don't know if you're really him. Prove it in a fight!
dialog.dexrider.nine.spot_dex.2: If you're really Dex, your punches will tell me. Here I come!
dialog.dexrider.nine.spot_player.1: Stay back! I don't know who you are or what this place is...
dialog.dexrider.nine.spot_player.2: I'm really sorry! But I can't let anyone attack me here!
dialog.dexrider.nine.hurt.1: Agh! I'm pushing the power too hard... the suit doesn't hold it the same here.
dialog.dexrider.nine.hurt.2: Not yet... I can still keep going!
dialog.dexrider.nine.panic.1: %s?! Hang on, I'm coming! I won't leave you alone here!
dialog.dexrider.nine.panic.2: They're attacking %s! Smash, smash, no time to think!
dialog.dexrider.nine.convinced.1: That fighting style... the cards, the rhythm... it IS you, Kagami-kun! Sorry, I wasn't sure.
dialog.dexrider.nine.convinced.2: It's you... it's really you! I'm so sorry, I was afraid it was a trap.
dialog.dexrider.nine.retreat.1: I can't fall in a world I don't know! Retreating!
dialog.dexrider.nine.retreat.2: I need to regroup! I'll be back!
dialog.dexrider.nine.suit.1: My suit says the air here isn't breathable for me. If I transform back... I wouldn't survive. So I'll stay as Nine.
dialog.dexrider.nine.suit.2: The suit's system says this world's atmosphere would hurt me. I can't take it off, but I can still help you like this.
dialog.dexrider.nine.summoned.1: I'm here, Kagami-kun! Let's go together!
dialog.dexrider.nine.summoned.2: Nine, ready to fight! What's the plan?
dialog.dexrider.nine.home.1: Heading home to recover. Call me anytime!
dialog.dexrider.nine.home.2: I'll rest a bit. Take care, Kagami-kun!
dialog.dexrider.nine.down.1: Sorry... I overdid the power again...
dialog.dexrider.nine.down.2: I need... a moment... don't you give up!
dialog.dexrider.nine.chat.1: Hey, %s, does your suit warn you about the air here too? I'm scared of being stuck like this forever.
dialog.dexrider.nine.chat.2: %s, I've been writing down everything in this world. Creepers are terrifying!
dialog.dexrider.nine.reply.1: Yeah, %s! As long as we're together we'll figure it out.
dialog.dexrider.nine.reply.2: Haha, you're right, %s. Kagami-kun will get us out of here.
dialog.dexrider.nine.reunion.1: We're all here! Kagami-kun... you did it!
dialog.dexrider.nine.reunion.2: All together again... I can feel the Driver reacting.
dialog.dexrider.nine.portal.1: Look! The Driver's signal and ours are opening a portal!
dialog.dexrider.nine.portal.2: It's a portal! It's the way home!
dialog.dexrider.nine.farewell.1: Thank you for finding us, Kagami-kun. I'm leaving you my bike, take care of it. See you on the other side!
dialog.dexrider.nine.farewell.2: I'll never forget this world. If you need me, call and I'll cross back. The Nine Striker is yours!
dialog.dexrider.nine.return.1: I crossed the portal as soon as I heard you! Where's the danger?
dialog.dexrider.nine.return.2: I'm back! A hero always answers the call.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.lost.1: Signal from Yusuke's Driver... weak, but real. My son is in this world. I'll find him.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.lost.2: I got here by accident, but I'm not leaving without him. Let's follow the signal.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.spot_dex.1: That Driver belongs to my son. If you're not Yusuke, you'll explain where you got it.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.spot_dex.2: You look like Dex. Let's see if you fight like him. Henshin!
dialog.dexrider.cipher.spot_player.1: I don't know you. Keep your distance.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.spot_player.2: Easy. But if you come at me armed, I won't be.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.hurt.1: I'm getting too old for this...
dialog.dexrider.cipher.hurt.2: Fine... I've got your rhythm now. It won't happen again.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.convinced.1: ...Yes. I taught you that guard. You're Yusuke. Come here, son.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.convinced.2: That way of closing the distance... it's mine. It's you, Yusuke. Sorry for the test.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.retreat.1: I'm pulling back. Not worth finishing this here.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.retreat.2: Enough. I'm leaving before this gets ugly.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.suit.1: My Rider System filters this world's air, so I can take the suit off. The U.A. kids aren't that lucky.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.suit.2: The Kagami system adapts: I can walk around without the suit here. They can't... their suits say they wouldn't survive.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.summoned.2: Made it. Show me the target.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.home.1: Back to the workshop. Call me if you need me.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.home.2: I'll go check the gear. Take care, Yusuke.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.down.1: Tch... I slipped. I need a while.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.down.2: I'm fine... I just need rest.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.chat.1: %s, how's the suit holding up? If you need me to check something, say so.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.chat.2: %s, stay close to Yusuke. He's stubborn, but he knows what he's doing.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.reunion.2: So that's what the signal was about... it was calling us all to you.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.portal.1: The Kamen Ride resonance opened the way. It's stable. Let's go.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.portal.2: A portal. They calibrated it together without realizing.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Cipher Runner, son. I tuned it myself. See you at home.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.farewell.2: I'll go first to secure the other side. The bike is yours. I'm proud of you.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.return.1: Crossed as soon as you called. What happened?
dialog.dexrider.cipher.return.2: I'm here. The portal still works fine.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.relax.1: Done. Taking this off, it's heavy.
dialog.dexrider.spore.lost.1: The spores don't recognize anything here... noko. Kagami-kun, where are you?
dialog.dexrider.spore.lost.2: If I spread the network far enough, I'll feel the Driver's signal... noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.spot_dex.1: I feel Kagami-kun's Driver on you... but the spores aren't sure. Sorry, I have to check, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.spot_dex.2: Is it really you? If it isn't... I won't let you keep his Driver!
dialog.dexrider.spore.spot_player.1: Don't come closer, noko! The spores tell me everything you do!
dialog.dexrider.spore.spot_player.2: Sorry... I don't trust anyone here yet.
dialog.dexrider.spore.hurt.1: Ow, ow, ow! This isn't my thing, noko!
dialog.dexrider.spore.hurt.2: I'm not a fighter... but I won't give up either.
dialog.dexrider.spore.panic.1: %s is in danger! The spores felt it, noko!
dialog.dexrider.spore.panic.2: No, no, no! Let go of %s!
dialog.dexrider.spore.convinced.1: The spores recognize you... you're Kagami-kun. Sorry I doubted, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.convinced.2: It's you... I stayed with you once when no one else did. I wasn't going to leave you now either.
dialog.dexrider.spore.suit.1: My suit says this air isn't good for me... noko. I can't take it off, but the spore network works perfectly here.
dialog.dexrider.spore.suit.2: I can't transform back in this world. At least the suit is comfy, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.summoned.1: Here I am, noko! The network's up: I know where everyone is.
dialog.dexrider.spore.summoned.2: I'm here! Who do we need to find?
dialog.dexrider.spore.home.1: Back to my mushroom home, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.home.2: Going to rest. The network keeps watch!
dialog.dexrider.spore.down.1: Uuh... I ran out of spores, noko...
dialog.dexrider.spore.chat.1: %s, did you know there are mushrooms here that almost glow? Almost, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.chat.2: %s, the spores feel something weird in the caves. Let's not go alone.
dialog.dexrider.spore.reunion.1: The spores feel all of us together! We did it, noko!
dialog.dexrider.spore.reunion.2: Everyone's here... I'm not scared anymore.
dialog.dexrider.spore.portal.1: The spores feel air from home on the other side, noko!
dialog.dexrider.spore.portal.2: A portal! It smells like our world!
dialog.dexrider.spore.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Myco Hurricane, noko. Its trail will warn you of everything. Thank you, Kagami-kun!
dialog.dexrider.spore.farewell.2: Goodbye... no, see you later. Call me anytime, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.return.1: Back through the portal, noko! What do you need?
dialog.dexrider.spore.return.2: The spores told me you were calling!
dialog.dexrider.forge.lost.1: Let's analyze calmly: a world of blocks, plentiful resources... and Kagami-san's Driver signal to the north.
dialog.dexrider.forge.lost.2: I must find Kagami-san. In the meantime, I can create whatever I need from these materials.
dialog.dexrider.forge.spot_dex.1: That Driver belongs to Kagami-san. Please forgive me, but I must verify your identity.
dialog.dexrider.forge.spot_dex.2: If you are Kagami-san, you'll know how to answer this strategy. En garde!
dialog.dexrider.forge.spot_player.1: Please don't come closer. I don't know your intentions.
dialog.dexrider.forge.hurt.2: I need more material to create!
dialog.dexrider.forge.panic.1: %s! Hold on, I'll create a shield!
dialog.dexrider.forge.convinced.1: That response... only Kagami-san would fight like that. My deepest apologies.
dialog.dexrider.forge.convinced.2: It's you. Forgive me for doubting, Kagami-san; it was the prudent thing to do.
dialog.dexrider.forge.retreat.1: I'll withdraw and rethink my strategy.
dialog.dexrider.forge.retreat.2: A tactical retreat is also a victory.
dialog.dexrider.forge.suit.1: My suit indicates the air here would be dangerous for me. I can't take it off, but I can create with it just fine.
dialog.dexrider.forge.suit.2: According to the suit's readings, I wouldn't survive this atmosphere without it. I'll remain as Forge.
dialog.dexrider.forge.summoned.1: Forge, present. What's the plan, Kagami-san?
dialog.dexrider.forge.summoned.2: I'm here. I already have three ideas for this fight.
dialog.dexrider.forge.home.1: Returning to my makeshift workshop. Call me when you need me.
dialog.dexrider.forge.down.1: I overdid the creating... I need rest.
dialog.dexrider.forge.chat.1: %s, I've catalogued this world's minerals. Diamond is surprisingly useful.
dialog.dexrider.forge.chat.2: %s, shall we build a decent shelter?
dialog.dexrider.forge.reunion.1: Everyone gathered. Kagami-san, your leadership was impeccable.
dialog.dexrider.forge.reunion.2: We did it. Now we can think about going back.
dialog.dexrider.forge.portal.1: Our Riders' resonance opened a stable portal!
dialog.dexrider.forge.portal.2: It's a portal. I estimate it will take us home.
dialog.dexrider.forge.farewell.1: I leave you the Machine Forger, Kagami-san. You can create bridges with it. It was an honor.
dialog.dexrider.forge.farewell.2: Thank you for everything. The bike is in your care.
dialog.dexrider.forge.return.1: I crossed as soon as you called. What shall I create?
dialog.dexrider.forge.return.2: Forge, back. I bring new ideas.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.lost.2: Everyone here can see me shine... so weird and so pretty. But I want to find Kagami-kun.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.spot_dex.1: Kagami-kun?! ...Wait, what if it's not you? Let's see if you can catch me!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.spot_dex.2: That Driver is Kagami-kun's! Prove it's you!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.spot_player.1: Eeek! Stay back! I'll blind you!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.spot_player.2: Oops, someone saw me! I need to get used to that!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.convinced.1: It IS you! Kagami-kun! I found you!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.convinced.2: It's you... sorry, sorry, sorry! I was so scared!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.suit.1: My suit says the air here is no good for me... so I can't take it off. But this way everyone sees me, and I love it!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.suit.2: I can't transform back here. That's fine: with the suit, everyone can see me.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.summoned.2: I'm here, Kagami-kun! Who do we dazzle?
dialog.dexrider.mirage.chat.1: %s! Did you see my reflection in the water? I look amazing!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.chat.2: %s, do you think this world has mirrors?
dialog.dexrider.mirage.reunion.1: We're all here! We did it!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.reunion.2: Everyone together! This calls for a party!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.portal.1: Whoa, a portal! It shines more than me!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Mirror Shooter! Nobody will be able to follow you! Thank you, Kagami-kun!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.farewell.2: See you soon! Call me and I'll come back shining!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.return.1: I'm back! Did you miss me?
dialog.dexrider.mirage.return.2: Crossed the portal! Shining as always!
dialog.dexrider.proto.lost.1: A whole world made of blocks! My babies and I could build anything here! ...But first, find Kagami.
dialog.dexrider.proto.lost.2: The Driver's signal... what an interesting frequency! Let's follow it.
dialog.dexrider.proto.spot_dex.1: That Driver! I want to see if it works like Kagami's! Field test!
dialog.dexrider.proto.spot_dex.2: Are you Kagami? Time to check with my babies!
dialog.dexrider.proto.panic.2: Nobody touches %s without going through my inventions!
dialog.dexrider.proto.convinced.1: You ARE Kagami! Your Driver responded just like in the workshop!
dialog.dexrider.proto.convinced.2: It's you! I knew my calculations were right!
dialog.dexrider.proto.suit.1: The suit says the air here is no good for me. I can't take it off, but it has four ports for my babies!
dialog.dexrider.proto.suit.2: I can't transform back here. Perfect: I get to work in the suit all day.
dialog.dexrider.proto.summoned.1: Proto, ready with a new module!
dialog.dexrider.proto.summoned.2: I'm here! What are we testing today?
dialog.dexrider.proto.chat.1: %s, can I install a thruster on your suit?
dialog.dexrider.proto.chat.2: %s, I found redstone! This changes everything!
dialog.dexrider.proto.reunion.1: Everyone together! And the combined signal is huge!
dialog.dexrider.proto.reunion.2: We did it! Can I study this before we go?
dialog.dexrider.proto.portal.1: A portal! I need to study it! ...Okay, let's cross first.
dialog.dexrider.proto.portal.2: It works! The signals made a portal!
dialog.dexrider.proto.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Proto Racer! It has module ports! Take care of it!
dialog.dexrider.proto.farewell.2: I'm taking this world's blueprints with me! See you, Kagami!
dialog.dexrider.proto.return.1: I'm back! And I brought upgrades!
message.dexrider.portal_closed: The portal closes. They went back to their world... but if you call them (B key), they'll cross back to fight with you.
dialog.dexrider.warden.lost.1: Signal from Yusuke's Driver, heading south. Protocol: locate, verify, protect.
dialog.dexrider.warden.lost.2: Got here by accident. Doesn't change the procedure: find my nephew and leave.
dialog.dexrider.warden.spot_dex.1: That Driver belongs to my nephew. Identify yourself or I'll do it for you.
dialog.dexrider.warden.spot_dex.2: Identity verification. I won't hold back.
dialog.dexrider.warden.spot_player.2: Keep your hands where I can see them.
dialog.dexrider.warden.hurt.2: Good. That was a good hit.
dialog.dexrider.warden.panic.2: Nobody lays a hand on %s. Nobody.
dialog.dexrider.warden.convinced.1: Four touches with overlapping tones... only you do that, Yusuke. Verified.
dialog.dexrider.warden.convinced.2: It's you. Noting it in the report: subject is who he claims. Good to see you.
dialog.dexrider.warden.retreat.2: Falling back. I'll return with backup.
dialog.dexrider.warden.suit.1: My Rider System filters the air: I can go without the suit here. The U.A. kids can't. Keep an eye on them.
dialog.dexrider.warden.suit.2: We Kagami adapt. I can take off the suit; they wouldn't survive this atmosphere.
dialog.dexrider.warden.summoned.1: Warden in position. Give me a target.
dialog.dexrider.warden.home.1: Back to my post. Let me know.
dialog.dexrider.warden.home.2: End of shift. You rest too.
dialog.dexrider.warden.chat.1: %s, everything in order? Report any anomaly.
dialog.dexrider.warden.chat.2: %s, I'm setting up a perimeter. Stay inside.
dialog.dexrider.warden.portal.2: The way is open. I'll bring up the rear.
dialog.dexrider.warden.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Warden Interceptor. Use it responsibly. See you at the Commission.
dialog.dexrider.warden.farewell.2: I'll cross last. Take care of your father... and yourself.
dialog.dexrider.warden.return.2: Came through the portal. Give me the report.
dialog.dexrider.warden.relax.1: Area clear. Taking off the suit.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.lost.1: Yusuke? I can feel his Driver... somewhere close. Oh, I hope he's eating well.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.lost.2: Three exits, a hill, a river... okay. Now to find my nephew.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.spot_dex.1: That's Yusuke's Driver... but I have to be sure. Sorry if it hurts a little.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.spot_dex.2: If you're my nephew, you'll know how to dodge from above. Here I come!
dialog.dexrider.psyga.spot_player.1: Oh, who are you? Don't come too close, dear.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.spot_player.2: Sorry, I can't trust anyone yet.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.hurt.1: Ow! I'm not telling anyone at home about this.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.panic.1: %s! Hold on, I'm coming down right now!
dialog.dexrider.psyga.convinced.1: It's you, Yusuke! Come here, let me hug you! ...Suit and all, I guess.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.convinced.2: It is you... sorry, sweetie. Here, I have a kitten sticker for you.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.suit.1: My Rider System lets me breathe here, so I can take off the suit. The little U.A. friends can't. We have to look after them.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.suit.2: I can walk around without the suit in this world. The kids can't... their suits say they wouldn't make it.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.summoned.1: Your aunt is here! Who needs a lesson?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.home.1: Heading home. Did you eat today?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.down.1: Oh... I need to sit for a bit.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.down.2: I'm fine, I'm fine... just tired.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.chat.1: %s, want a sticker? I have kitten ones.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.chat.2: %s, have you eaten? You look skinny.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.reunion.1: Everyone together! Like a real family!
dialog.dexrider.psyga.reunion.2: You did it, Yusuke. I'm so proud.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.portal.1: A portal... it smells like the mountain house.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.portal.2: The way home! Everyone hold hands, okay?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Psyga Glider, dear. It has a kitten on the tank. Fly carefully!
dialog.dexrider.psyga.farewell.2: See you soon. And this time we really are getting that ice cream.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.return.1: Your aunt is here! What happened?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.return.2: Flew right through! Where's the trouble?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.relax.2: All calm. Want me to bring you something to eat?
dialog.dexrider.orga.lost.1: Hmph. A world of blocks. My knee hates it. Where's the boy?
dialog.dexrider.orga.lost.2: Fifty years with the belt and I've never seen anything like this. I'll find Yusuke.
dialog.dexrider.orga.spot_dex.1: That Driver sounds like my grandson's. Let's see if your cards lie as well as his.
dialog.dexrider.orga.spot_dex.2: I hear your cards, boy. If you're Yusuke, you know what's coming.
dialog.dexrider.orga.spot_player.1: Step aside. I have no patience and no knee for this.
dialog.dexrider.orga.hurt.1: My knee... never mind. Keep going.
dialog.dexrider.orga.hurt.2: Good. You hit like a Kagami.
dialog.dexrider.orga.panic.2: Touch %s and you deal with me, boy.
dialog.dexrider.orga.convinced.1: You cut the card mid-tone. I taught you that lie. You're Yusuke.
dialog.dexrider.orga.convinced.2: No impostor fights this stubbornly. You're my grandson.
dialog.dexrider.orga.retreat.1: Hmph. Ten minutes with the belt and my knee begs for mercy. I'm out.
dialog.dexrider.orga.suit.1: My Rider System lets me go without the suit here. At my age, that's welcome. The kids from your school aren't so lucky.
dialog.dexrider.orga.suit.2: I can take off the belt in this world. Those youngsters can't. Protect them.
dialog.dexrider.orga.summoned.1: Hmph. I'm here. Make it quick.
dialog.dexrider.orga.home.2: I'm off. Call me if they overwhelm you.
dialog.dexrider.orga.down.1: Ten minutes... I can't take more.
dialog.dexrider.orga.chat.1: %s, have you ever listened to how the cards sound? Listen closely.
dialog.dexrider.orga.chat.2: %s, in my day we fixed this with tea.
dialog.dexrider.orga.reunion.2: Hmph. You did it. Your grandmother would be proud.
dialog.dexrider.orga.portal.1: A portal. The sound of all the cards together opened it.
dialog.dexrider.orga.portal.2: Finally. Let's leave this square world.
dialog.dexrider.orga.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Orga Monarch. Don't scratch it. I'll wait for you at the mountain house.
dialog.dexrider.orga.farewell.2: Cross whenever you want. And keep lying with your cards, you're good at it.
dialog.dexrider.orga.return.1: Hmph. I came. What is it?
dialog.dexrider.orga.return.2: Orga, back. Make it worth it.
dialog.dexrider.orga.relax.1: Belt off. My knee thanks me.
message.dexrider.spore_rod_anchor: Spore Rod planted: the network senses %s creatures
dialog.dexrider.pair.nine.forge.1: Yaoyorozu-san, how much material do you have left? If you need it, I'll cover you while you create.
dialog.dexrider.pair.nine.forge.1.r: Thank you, Midoriya-san. Half a minute is enough for a decent shield.
dialog.dexrider.pair.nine.forge.2: Yaoyorozu-san, your suit swaps halves... how do you decide which one? I want to write it down!
dialog.dexrider.pair.nine.forge.2.r: It depends on the problem, Midoriya-san: first the tool, then the material. Go ahead and note it.
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.mirage.1.r: Yaomomo! Call me Toru! ...And thank you! Finally someone says it!
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.mirage.2: Hagakure-san, if you reflect the light of my magnesium flare, we could blind half an army.
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.mirage.2.r: Shiny girls combo! I love it, Yaomomo!
dialog.dexrider.pair.mirage.nine.1: Midoriya-kun! Can you see me? Tell me you can see me!
dialog.dexrider.pair.mirage.nine.1.r: Y-yes, Hagakure-san! I can see you perfectly... it's weird, but I'm really happy.
dialog.dexrider.pair.mirage.nine.2: Midoriya-kun, when we go back, do you think Kagami-kun will still see me like this?
dialog.dexrider.pair.mirage.nine.2.r: He could already see you before, Hagakure-san. That won't change.
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.forge.1: Yaoyorozu, lend me a half! I just want to see how it fits the other one!
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.forge.1.r: Hatsume-san, it doesn't come apart. And no, not with a screwdriver either.
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.forge.2: Yaoyorozu, if your cannon had an expansion port...
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.forge.2.r: It already has one, Hatsume-san. It's called "don't touch it".
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.nine.1: Midoriya! Can your suit take the recoil? Let me measure it with a sensor!
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.nine.1.r: R-right now, Hatsume-san? We're in another world!
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.nine.2: Midoriya, your Smash broke all my gauges. I love it!
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.mirage.1: Hagakure-san, the spores feel you just like in the forest, noko. But now I can see you too.
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.mirage.1.r: Kinoko-chan! Like the night at camp... but this time nobody gets lost.
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.mirage.2: Hagakure-san, aren't you scared of this world, noko?
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.mirage.2.r: A little. But I shine brighter when I'm with friends, Kinoko-chan.
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.nine.1: Midoriya-kun, the spore network says there are creepers forty meters away, noko.
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.nine.1.r: Thanks, Komori-san! You're better than a radar!
dialog.dexrider.pair.spore.nine.2: Midoriya-kun, Kagami-kun talks about you a lot, noko.
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.cipher.1: Mr. Kagami, could you check where my halves join? You understand modular Drivers.
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.cipher.1.r: It's well made, Yaoyorozu-san. Better than my first belt.
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.cipher.2: Mr. Kagami, how does your system handle this atmosphere?
dialog.dexrider.pair.forge.cipher.2.r: It filters the air, Yaoyorozu-san. I wish yours did the same.
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.cipher.1: Mr. Modular Driver! Can I see your belt? Just for a bit!
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.cipher.1.r: No, Hatsume. Not here, not in the other world.
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.cipher.2: Mr. Modular Driver! I made you an upgrade!
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.cipher.2.r: Hatsume... what did you do to my belt?
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.warden.1: Isamu-san, about our secret meeting... is it still on?
dialog.dexrider.pair.proto.warden.1.r: Keep your voice down, Hatsume. And yes.
dialog.dexrider.pair.nine.warden.1: Agent Kagami, is there a protocol for block worlds?
dialog.dexrider.pair.nine.warden.1.r: There is now, Midoriya. I'm writing it.
dialog.dexrider.pair.mirage.psyga.1: Nagisa-san! Can I have a sticker too?
dialog.dexrider.pair.mirage.psyga.1.r: Of course, Toru-chan! A shiny one, just for you.
dialog.dexrider.pair.psyga.spore.1: Kinoko-chan, do you want a little mushroom sticker?
dialog.dexrider.pair.cipher.warden.1: Isamu, are you still writing reports for the Commission from here?
dialog.dexrider.pair.cipher.warden.1.r: Out of habit, Takumi. Nobody gets them. I write them anyway.
dialog.dexrider.pair.cipher.warden.2: Isamu, thanks for looking after Yusuke when I couldn't.
dialog.dexrider.pair.cipher.warden.2.r: No need, Takumi. That's what uncles are for.
dialog.dexrider.pair.warden.psyga.1: Nagisa, count the exits. Out of habit.
dialog.dexrider.pair.warden.psyga.1.r: Already did, Isamu-nii. Three. And a river.
dialog.dexrider.pair.warden.psyga.2: Nagisa, stay behind me if this gets ugly.
dialog.dexrider.pair.warden.psyga.2.r: Isamu-nii, I fly. You stay behind me.
dialog.dexrider.pair.psyga.cipher.1: Takumi-nii... do you still have the kitten sticker?
dialog.dexrider.pair.psyga.cipher.1.r: It's still where you stuck it, Nagisa. I never took it off.
dialog.dexrider.pair.psyga.cipher.2: Takumi-nii, you eat too little. Have a manju.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.cipher.2: Takumi, your boy fights better than you did at his age.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.cipher.2.r: I know, Father. That's why I don't tell him.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.warden.1: Isamu, stop writing down everything I do.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.warden.1.r: It's protocol, Father. You're in the report too.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.warden.2: Isamu... I never taught you about the tones, did I?
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.warden.2.r: No, Father. I learned it from the boy.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.psyga.1: Nagisa, stop putting stickers on me.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.psyga.1.r: No, Dad. The kitten looks good on your knee.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.psyga.2: Nagisa, my knee is killing me.
dialog.dexrider.pair.orga.psyga.2.r: I told you to bring the cane, Dad.
dialog.dexrider.nine.form_change.2: Analyze... this calls for another form. %s!
dialog.dexrider.nine.rising.1: One For All, Full Cowl... fifteen percent! Rising!
dialog.dexrider.nine.rising.2: The suit can take the recoil... then I'm going all out! Rising!

guide.dexrider.page1:
§4§lTAKUMI'S NOTEBOOK§r

If you're reading this, the Driver chose you.

It isn't a weapon. It's a tool to get there sooner.

§8— T. K.
guide.dexrider.page2:
§lHENSHIN§r

1. Carry the Dex Driver.
2. Right-click with Kamen Ride: Dex to load it.
3. §lV§r: KAMEN RIDE!

V again to go back. Your armor is stored in the chestplate.
guide.dexrider.page3:
§lTHE SUIT§r

+5 hearts, you take 25% less and hit 25% harder.

After 5 s without hits, light wounds close.

It can't be removed and isn't dropped on death.
guide.dexrider.page4:
§lSCANNING§r

While transformed, the Driver copies what it SEES in real use: weapons, powers, moves.

Within 20 blocks, in line of sight, looking at it.

Complex things need several samples.
guide.dexrider.page5:
§lWHAT TO SCAN§r

Swords, bows, tridents, lightning, guardians, golems.
Ghast, blaze, stray: forms.
Dolphin or axolotl: Hydro.
Breeze: Gale. Vex: Razor Feather.
Explosions: Nitro Burst.
Mace or warden: Ground Wave.
Enderman: Overclock.
guide.dexrider.page6:
§lLEVELING UP§r

Scan something you already have and the card is replaced by a better version (Lv. 1-3).

Form Rides and Attack Rides grow this way. There's no going back.
guide.dexrider.page7:
§lFAMILIES§r

§dKamen Ride§r: identities.
§cAttack Ride§r: techniques.
§6Armed Ride§r: weapons.
§9Form Ride§r: forms (one at a time).
§aVehicle Ride§r: bikes.

Each card in a family makes it stronger.
guide.dexrider.page8:
§lKEYS§r

§lR§r ability (Shift: basic)
§lG§r the Ride Booker
§lHold wheel§r or §lC§r: selector
§lAlt + wheel§r switch card
  (release Alt to use)
§lZ / X§r prev. / next card
§lH§r Archive  §lJ§r Missions
§lB§r Rider friends
guide.dexrider.page9:
§lRIDE BOOKER§r

It opens like a book: five decks, three pages each.

Click a card: it comes out and is used.

§l★ Selector§r: your favorites.
§lOrganize§r: move cards.
guide.dexrider.page10:
§lATTACK RIDE§r

§lOverclock§r: everything slows down.
§lGale§r: wind that pushes and deflects.
§lRazor Feather§r: seeking feathers.
§lNitro Burst§r: detonations.
§lGround Wave§r: a wave through the ground.
guide.dexrider.page11:
§lTHE LOST§r

Other Riders fell into this world and don't know where they are.

Beat them in a real fight: their Kamen Ride joins your deck and they can become friends.
guide.dexrider.page12:
§lEMOTION§r

§5Violent§r: at the edge. Strength, speed and a price.

§9Heroic§r: when someone you protect gets hit.

In both, choosing a card uses it.
guide.dexrider.page13:
§lK-TOUCH§r

With nine Kamen Rides the Driver forges the K-Touch and a Complete Form card.

With ten, press every crest, yours included.
guide.dexrider.page14:
§lONE RULE§r

As long as someone is listening, there's still time to say "no" before.

Not after.

§8— T. K.

dialog.dexrider.kaixa.lost.1: Yusuke's Driver pulled me here. Dad will want a report.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.lost.2: Blocks. Everything is blocks. Fine: you can finish anything if you have the parts.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.spot_dex.1: That Driver sounds like my nephew's. Let's see if it fights like him.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.spot_dex.2: Kamen Ride... I know that tone. Prove it.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.spot_player.1: Stay back. I don't have time for explanations.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.convinced.1: You read my tones before I read yours. U.A. doesn't teach that. You're Yusuke.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.convinced.2: Dad said only three people can read the cards. Now it's four. It's you, nephew.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.retreat.1: I'm pulling back. I don't leave things half done: I'll be back.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.retreat.2: Falling back. This ends another day.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.suit.1: My Rider System lets me take the suit off here, but I'd rather not in front of anyone.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.suit.2: Kagami adapt. Your U.A. friends wouldn't be so lucky with this air.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.summoned.1: Kaixa. Tell me what needs finishing.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.summoned.2: I'm here. You point, I finish.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.home.1: Back to the workshop. There's something I want to finish.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.home.2: I'm off. Call me if anything's left half done.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.down.1: Ugh... I need a moment. Just one.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.down.2: Out of the fight. Don't tell Dad.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.chat.1: %s, ever finished something without the blueprints? I have.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.chat.2: %s, the second drawer always has what you're looking for.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.reunion.1: All together again. Dad would be... well. He'd be.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.reunion.2: You found everyone. That's called finishing the job.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.portal.1: The portal holds. Go through, I'll watch the edge.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.farewell.1: I'm leaving you the Cobalt Sidewinder. I finished it without blueprints, so take care of it. And call Nagisa: she misses you.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.farewell.2: Crossing. Next time we meet, we fight without tones.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.return.2: Came through the portal. Tell me where.

note.dexrider.gunma.1:
Project Leash.

Goal: a Rider System that can be switched off from outside.

The wearer's fear opens the channel. We call it Violent Emotion.
note.dexrider.gunma.2:
Test 14.

The wearer keeps some control: they choose who to aim at, not whether to aim.

For us, that's enough.
note.dexrider.gunma.3:
Margin note, different handwriting:

"This isn't a leash. It's a wound we left open."
note.dexrider.gunma.4:
Subject 12.

Admitted at age twelve. Reflex modification complete. Responds well to pressure.
note.dexrider.gunma.5:
The subject asks about home every night.

Recommendation: do not answer.
note.dexrider.gunma.6:
The subject escaped during transfer.

A family wearer is being sent to retrieve them.
note.dexrider.gunma.7:
The basement gave way.

The columns weren't built for what happened down here.
note.dexrider.gunma.8:
Someone else was here that night. They shouldn't have been.

Close the laboratory.

§lTONES§r

Every card sounds different. Orga and Kaixa read tones: don't repeat the same card.

§lShift+Alt§r: decoy.
Two cards in a row: overlapping tones.
guide.dexrider.page16:
§lTHE LENT DRIVER§r

V without the Driver: you revoke it.

Each bearer leaves their form in your deck.
guide.dexrider.page17:
§lNO FEAR§r

Upgrade Form: born when the Driver has felt both Emotions.

Enter the Complete Form from it and the card rises to Lv.2.
message.dexrider.architect_intro: «Ten Riders that switch on with a button. And you scan. You're the button I was missing.»
message.dexrider.architect_phase2: «I'm reading you. Every hit teaches me how you hit.»

message.dexrider.signal_no: «No.» — §bthe Signal snaps§r. The Architect is stunned!
message.dexrider.signal_hit: The Signal pulls at your blood. Your allies lose control for a moment.
message.dexrider.core_spent: The Core is dark. Nothing answers anymore.

note.dexrider.signal.1:
The mountain house thinks the Rider System is a bloodline.

It's a switch.
note.dexrider.signal.2:
The leash isn't a flaw. It's half of the design.

Whoever holds the frequency holds the Rider.
note.dexrider.signal.3: The Kagami never wanted to use it. Genzo has worn it for fifty years and calls it family.
note.dexrider.signal.4:
Ten pods. Ten Riders that switch on with a button.

We're missing the one who scans: the one who learns from all of them.
note.dexrider.signal.5:
The boy from the Sports Festival. His Driver copies what it sees.

If the Signal reaches him, he'll copy us.
note.dexrider.signal.6:
In the margin, different handwriting:

"He says no. He said it out loud."

The Kagami keep a spare Dex Driver in the mountain house, in the basement workshop, with its first three cards.

The Kagami Compass points to it (compass + red dye + gold ingot).

Transformed, after trading blows, the Driver reads your target: its life, your hit, its hit, and roughly how many hits are left on each side.

mission.dexrider.mountain_house.title: The house is open
mission.dexrider.mountain_house.letter1: "The mountain house is open. It always was."
mission.dexrider.henshin.title: Henshin
mission.dexrider.henshin.letter1: "The Driver is not an ornament. Put it on and insert the Dex card."
mission.dexrider.henshin.letter2: "The first time is hard. After that, the body remembers."
mission.dexrider.first_scan.title: What the Driver copies
mission.dexrider.first_scan.letter1: "Nephew! I heard you already transformed. Your Driver isn't like ours: it copies what it sees."
mission.dexrider.first_scan.letter2: "Watch something fight up close, transformed, and let it learn. I left you something sweet for the road."
mission.dexrider.form_ride.title: Change forms
mission.dexrider.form_ride.letter2: "One form alone doesn't win fights. Use a Form Ride and then we'll talk. — T."
mission.dexrider.hydro.title: Under the water
mission.dexrider.hydro.letter1: "As a girl I spent hours watching the dolphins. Tetsuya says it's wasted time."
mission.dexrider.hydro.letter2: "I think your Driver could learn something from them. Will you show me when you have it?"
mission.dexrider.parry.title: The tones
mission.dexrider.parry.letter1: "Every card sounds different. Whoever knows how to listen knows what you'll do before you do."
mission.dexrider.parry.letter2: "First learn not to take the hit: Shift right before it lands."
mission.dexrider.parry.goal: Parry a hit at the right moment.
mission.dexrider.ally.title: A real Rider
mission.dexrider.ally.letter1: "There are lost Riders roaming at night. They're looking for the real Dex."
mission.dexrider.ally.letter2: "Show them it's you. No tricks. — T."
mission.dexrider.ally.goal: Defeat a lost Rider as Dex.
mission.dexrider.violent_emotion.title: The leash
mission.dexrider.violent_emotion.letter1: "There's something Dad won't tell you. Our Rider System has a leash: the Violent Emotion."
mission.dexrider.violent_emotion.letter2: "If you ever feel it, you're not alone. Write to me afterwards, okay?"
mission.dexrider.heroic_emotion.title: The way out
mission.dexrider.heroic_emotion.letter1: "Mom left a way out in the system. Dad calls it the Heroic Emotion."
mission.dexrider.heroic_emotion.letter2: "I don't know how you find it. I think it has to do with why you fight."
mission.dexrider.gunma_lab.title: Gunma
mission.dexrider.gunma_lab.letter1: "There is an abandoned lab in Gunma. I have not been back in twenty years."
mission.dexrider.gunma_lab.letter2: "Whatever remains there should not fall into other hands. Be careful."
mission.dexrider.kaixa.title: The youngest brother
mission.dexrider.kaixa.letter1: "You've talked to everyone but me. I'm in the mountain forests."
mission.dexrider.commission_depot.title: The depot
mission.dexrider.commission_depot.letter: "Dai-Shocker is going to raid a Commission depot. I shouldn't be telling you this."
"But family things are kept there. Get there before they do."
mission.dexrider.architect.title: The Signal
mission.dexrider.architect.letter1: "There is a signal underground that calls to the leash. The family did not put it there."
mission.dexrider.architect.letter2: "If whoever put it there reads your tones, don't fight like me. Say no in time. — G.K."

dialog.dexrider.nine.see_mine.1: Kagami-kun, your pickaxe rhythm is perfect! I'm writing all of this down.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_mine.2: Hit, hit, pause... are you reading the hardness of each block? Amazing.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_mine.3: If you swing at that angle you waste less energy. I have to try it!
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_mine.4: Ore spotted... there, on your left! Sorry, I got excited.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_mine.5: We didn't have mines this deep back home. This is fascinating!
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_chop.1: Bottom to top... of course, so it doesn't fall on you!
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_chop.2: That tree came down in four hits. I'm taking notes, Kagami-kun.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_chop.3: You always replant? That's what a real hero would do.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_chop.4: Wood for building... what are you making? Tell me!
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_chop.5: Picking the thickest trunk first... that makes sense.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_farm.1: Harvest and plant again... it's a perfect cycle.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_farm.2: Ripe wheat is a different color! I never noticed.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_farm.4: How many days does it take to grow? I'm timing it.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_farm.5: Kagami-kun, your rows are perfectly straight!
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_build.1: That's going to be a base! Does it have a training room?
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_build.2: Block by block... like training with One For All. Patience.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_build.3: That wall could hold off a mid-rank villain, I think.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_build.4: I love seeing how you think about space. Keep going!
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_build.5: Can I suggest a window there? For keeping watch, I mean.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_craft.1: That combination makes that? I need to write it down now!
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_craft.2: The shape on the table matters... of course, it's like a blueprint.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_craft.3: You made that in seconds! Let me see it again.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_craft.4: Every recipe is like a special move. I'm memorizing them.
dialog.dexrider.nine.see_craft.5: Kagami-kun, will you teach me that one? I'll practice, I promise.
dialog.dexrider.nine.learn.1: Got it! I can %s now! I went over my notebook a thousand times.
dialog.dexrider.nine.learn.2: I think I can %s now. Thanks for teaching me, Kagami-kun!
dialog.dexrider.nine.learn.3: My notes worked: I know how to %s!
dialog.dexrider.nine.learn.4: Finally! I can %s... well, almost perfectly.
dialog.dexrider.nine.learn.5: Now I can %s too! Let me help you.
dialog.dexrider.nine.help.1: I'll help! I know how it's done now.
dialog.dexrider.nine.help.2: I'm with you, Kagami-kun! We'll finish twice as fast.
dialog.dexrider.nine.help.3: Leave this part to me. I practiced!
dialog.dexrider.nine.help.4: Let's do it together, like in training!
dialog.dexrider.nine.help.5: I can do it too! Look, I do it just like you.
dialog.dexrider.nine.job.1: Time to %s! I'll stay home and work.
dialog.dexrider.nine.job.2: Understood: I'll %s. I won't let you down!
dialog.dexrider.nine.job.3: I'll take care of it — I'll %s and keep count of everything.
dialog.dexrider.nine.job.4: An assignment... like an internship! I'll %s.
dialog.dexrider.nine.job.5: Yes! I'll %s. Leave it to me.
dialog.dexrider.nine.job_stop.1: Got it, stopping. That was good training!
dialog.dexrider.nine.job_stop.2: Done, I'll stop working. I wrote down how much I got.
dialog.dexrider.nine.job_stop.3: Okay, resting. Tell me if you need more!
dialog.dexrider.nine.job_stop.4: Stopping for now. That was fun!
dialog.dexrider.nine.job_stop.5: All right, back to guarding the house.
dialog.dexrider.nine.not_yet.1: I don't know how to %s yet... will you teach me? Do it near me.
dialog.dexrider.nine.not_yet.2: Sorry, I can't %s yet. I need to watch you a few more times.
dialog.dexrider.nine.not_yet.3: My notes on how to %s are incomplete. Show me again!
dialog.dexrider.nine.not_yet.4: I'm not ready to %s yet. Let me watch you first.
dialog.dexrider.nine.not_yet.5: Not yet... but if I watch you %s a couple more times, I'll get it.
dialog.dexrider.nine.find.1: Kagami-kun! I found something shiny! Is it what I think it is?
dialog.dexrider.nine.find.2: A rare ore! We have to keep this safe!
dialog.dexrider.nine.find.3: Look at this! All Might would be proud of this find!
dialog.dexrider.nine.find.4: Found it, found it! Sorry, I yelled.
dialog.dexrider.nine.find.5: This is worth a lot, right? I'll put it with the rest!
dialog.dexrider.nine.full.1: I can't carry any more... is there a chest near the house?
dialog.dexrider.nine.full.2: Kagami-kun, I need a chest to store all this.
dialog.dexrider.nine.full.3: My hands are full! A chest by my house, please.
dialog.dexrider.nine.full.4: There's nowhere to put what I find. Could you place a chest?
dialog.dexrider.nine.full.5: I can't keep going without a chest... help!
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_mine.2: Mine at eye level, Yusuke. You'll tire less.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_mine.3: Iron. Good for the workshop. Keep it.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_mine.4: Your grandfather mined like that. Don't tell him.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_mine.5: Watch out for lava. Look before you dig down.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_chop.2: Replant. What you take, you give back.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_chop.4: Chopping is engineering too: you decide how it falls.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_farm.1: Your mother had a garden. She did it the same way.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_farm.2: Plant in rows. Easier to water.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_farm.3: Your own food. That way nobody controls you.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_farm.4: Don't leave soil empty. It's a waste.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_farm.5: Good. An engineer has to eat too.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_build.1: Reinforce the corners. That's where it gives first.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_build.2: That design makes sense. I like it.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_build.4: Measure and level. That's how you build.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_build.5: If you want, I'll draw you a blueprint.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_craft.2: You lay out the table like the workshop. Good.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_craft.3: That's how you assemble it. No leftover parts.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_craft.4: I'd have done it the same way. Maybe faster.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.see_craft.5: Good tool. Take care of it.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.learn.1: I can %s now. Wasn't that hard.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.learn.2: Understood. I can %s whenever you want.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.learn.4: I know how to %s now. Thanks, son.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.learn.5: I can %s now. Just like in the workshop.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.help.3: Let me. I know how it goes.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.help.4: Let's go. Quietly, like in the workshop.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.job.3: I'll %s. Let me know if you need something else.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.job.4: I'll %s. Done. I'll come back with results.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.job.5: Understood. I'll %s until you say otherwise.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.job_stop.1: Stopping. I'll put the tools away.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.job_stop.5: Stopping here. Everything's in the chest.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.not_yet.1: I can't %s yet. Show me how you do it.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.not_yet.2: I don't know how to %s yet. Do it nearby and I'll watch.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.not_yet.3: To %s... I need to see the process a couple of times.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.not_yet.4: Not yet. Teach me to %s first.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.not_yet.5: I don't improvise. Show me how to %s.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.find.2: Good find. Don't waste it on nonsense.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.find.3: This is for something big. I'll store it.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.find.5: Back home this cost a fortune.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.full.1: I've got nowhere to put this. Place a chest by the house.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.full.2: No chest, no work. Organization first.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.full.3: I need a chest near the house, Yusuke.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.full.4: My hands are full. A chest.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.full.5: A good workshop has storage. Place a chest.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_mine.1: You hit hard, noko. The spores feel the tremor.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_mine.2: There's a hollow behind that stone, noko. Just so you know.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_mine.3: There are glowing mushrooms underground... have you seen them?
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_mine.4: Careful, the network feels water nearby, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_mine.5: Ore three blocks away! I felt it with the spores.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_chop.1: Trees have mushroom friends too, noko. Replant, okay?
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_chop.2: That trunk was healthy. I felt it through the network.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_chop.3: Smells like fresh wood... I love it, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_chop.4: Leave some leaves, mushrooms like the shade.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_chop.5: Nice cut! The ground is happy if you replant.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_farm.1: Planting is the best, noko! Plants talk to me... sort of.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_farm.2: That soil is good. I know, the network touches it.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_farm.3: The wheat was ready! Good eye.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_farm.4: I like that you take care of the soil, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_farm.5: Can I plant mushrooms next to it? Just a few.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_build.1: A house! Will it have a dark corner for my mushrooms?
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_build.3: That wall is damp inside. It's fine, I like it.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_build.4: Kagami-kun, it'd look cute with moss.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_build.5: Block by block, like a mushroom grows, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_craft.1: How did you know that's how it's made? Teach me!
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_craft.2: Crafting is like cooking... I think, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.see_craft.5: It's a little hard for me, but I want to learn that one.
dialog.dexrider.spore.learn.1: I can %s now, noko! The spores helped me!
dialog.dexrider.spore.learn.2: I did it! I can %s now.
dialog.dexrider.spore.learn.3: I can %s... it works! Thanks, Kagami-kun.
dialog.dexrider.spore.learn.4: I learned to %s, noko! So exciting!
dialog.dexrider.spore.learn.5: Now I know how to %s. The network remembers everything.
dialog.dexrider.spore.help.4: Let me help! I know how now.
dialog.dexrider.spore.help.5: Together, like in the forest at camp!
dialog.dexrider.spore.job.3: I'll stay and %s. The network keeps watch meanwhile.
dialog.dexrider.spore.job.5: Off to %s, noko! I'll come back with stuff.
dialog.dexrider.spore.job_stop.1: I'll stop, noko. That was nice.
dialog.dexrider.spore.job_stop.3: Stopping. The plants can rest too.
dialog.dexrider.spore.not_yet.1: I don't know how to %s yet, noko... teach me.
dialog.dexrider.spore.not_yet.2: Hmm, I still can't %s well. Do it near me.
dialog.dexrider.spore.not_yet.3: I need to watch you %s a few more times, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.not_yet.4: I can't %s yet... but I learn fast with plants!
dialog.dexrider.spore.not_yet.5: Not yet... can you show me how to %s?
dialog.dexrider.spore.find.1: Kagami-kun! Something's shining down here, noko!
dialog.dexrider.spore.find.2: I found a treasure! The network felt it first.
dialog.dexrider.spore.find.5: I found it! Well, the spores did.
dialog.dexrider.spore.full.1: I can't fit anything else, noko... a chest?
dialog.dexrider.spore.full.2: I need a chest near the house, please.
dialog.dexrider.spore.full.3: My pockets are full of stuff. A chest!
dialog.dexrider.spore.full.4: Help! Without a chest I can't store anything, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.full.5: Put a chest by my house, okay?
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_mine.1: Your pickaxe technique is very efficient, Kagami-san.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_mine.2: That ore contains iron. I could calculate its purity.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_mine.3: I'd suggest mining in a staircase; it's safer.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_mine.4: Interesting: every block has a different hardness.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_mine.5: I'm noting the pattern you use to mine.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_chop.1: Oak: sturdy structure and easy to carve.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_chop.2: Replanting is the right thing to do. Sustainability.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_chop.4: I could create many things with that wood.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_chop.5: I watch and learn. Forgive me if I stare too much.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_farm.1: Rotating the crops would improve the yield, if I may.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_farm.2: Being self-sufficient is important. Very sensible.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_farm.3: That wheat is at its optimal point.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_farm.5: I could create seeds, but growing them has its own merit.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_build.2: May I suggest a support in that corner?
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_build.3: The symmetry gives it elegance, Kagami-san.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_build.4: You build with great confidence. Admirable.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_build.5: This deserves a formal blueprint. Shall I draft one?
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_craft.1: That recipe is clever. I'll memorize it.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_craft.2: Understanding the structure is the first step to creating.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_craft.3: Fascinating. Every material has its place.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_craft.4: I'd create it with my Quirk, but this way is beautiful too.
dialog.dexrider.forge.see_craft.5: I'll add it to my crafting protocol.
dialog.dexrider.forge.learn.1: I can %s now. Thank you for the demonstration, Kagami-san.

dialog.dexrider.mirage.see_farm.5: I want to try! Can I?

dialog.dexrider.proto.see_mine.2: Iron? Gold? Give me everything that shines!

dialog.dexrider.proto.see_chop.4: That trunk has a nice grain!
dialog.dexrider.proto.see_chop.5: A tree falls, a prototype is born!
dialog.dexrider.proto.see_farm.1: Food? Oh right, people eat. I forgot.
dialog.dexrider.proto.see_farm.2: I could automate that with an irrigation module!
dialog.dexrider.proto.see_farm.3: Farming is slow... but necessary. I guess.
dialog.dexrider.proto.see_farm.4: That wheat would make good organic fuel!
dialog.dexrider.proto.see_farm.5: Hmm, I'm going to design a harvester!
dialog.dexrider.proto.see_build.1: That structure needs a workshop inside!
dialog.dexrider.proto.see_build.3: You build fast! Can I give you a robot arm?
dialog.dexrider.proto.see_build.4: That's a base! My babies need a room!

dialog.dexrider.proto.see_craft.3: That combination has potential! I'd add a thruster!

dialog.dexrider.proto.full.1: I can't fit anything else! I need a chest!

dialog.dexrider.proto.full.3: My pockets are full of materials!

dialog.dexrider.warden.see_mine.1: Good rhythm. Keep your footing stable.

dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_mine.1: Be careful down there, sweetie! Did you bring torches?

dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_mine.3: Don't go too deep without telling me, okay?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_mine.4: You're so strong! Are you eating well?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_mine.5: If you find something pretty, keep it for yourself.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_chop.1: Replant, sweetie! Trees need looking after.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_chop.2: That firewood will keep us warm in winter.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_chop.3: We chopped wood just like that at the mountain house.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_chop.4: Don't hurt yourself with the axe, please.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_chop.5: You're so good at it! You remind me of Tetsuya.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_farm.1: I love that you farm! That way you'll never go hungry.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_farm.2: We had a garden just like this at the mountain house.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_farm.3: That wheat makes a lot of bread. Shall I bake you some?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_farm.4: Plant a little more, just in case.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_farm.5: So tidy! Your grandmother would be proud.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_build.1: What a lovely little house! Will it have a kitchen?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_build.2: Put in a comfy bed, you need to sleep well.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_build.3: A window for the morning light, okay?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_build.4: I love it! Can I put a kitten sticker on it?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_build.5: You build with love, I can tell.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_craft.2: That's useful. Careful not to cut yourself.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_craft.3: Will you teach me? I always wanted to make things like that.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_craft.4: You do it so carefully. I like that.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.see_craft.5: Your dad made everything by hand too.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.learn.1: I can %s now, sweetie! Thanks for teaching me!
dialog.dexrider.psyga.learn.2: Look! I can %s now. I'm so proud!
dialog.dexrider.psyga.learn.3: I managed to %s! Your aunt learns fast, huh?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.learn.4: I learned to %s! Now I can help you with everything.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.learn.5: I can %s now. Nobody ever taught me anything like this before.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.help.2: Leave this part to me. You rest a little.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.help.4: Your aunt is here to help.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.help.5: Let's do it together! Like a family.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.job.1: I'll stay home and %s! You go on, don't worry.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.job.3: You want me to %s? Leave it to me.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.job.4: I'll %s. Bundle up if you go out!
dialog.dexrider.psyga.job.5: I'm happy to %s. That's what family is for.

dialog.dexrider.psyga.job_stop.4: I'll stop now, sweetie. Thanks for asking me!

dialog.dexrider.psyga.find.5: This is valuable. I'll leave it in the chest for you.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.full.1: Sweetie, I can't carry any more. A chest?

dialog.dexrider.psyga.full.3: My hands are full. Could you put a chest down?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.full.4: Without a chest I have nowhere to put it, sweetie.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.full.5: Could you place a chest near my house?
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_mine.1: Hmph. You mine better than your father did at your age.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_mine.2: Strike where the stone gives. Feel it.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_mine.3: On the mountain I learned to mine before I learned to fight.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_mine.4: Mind the gravel. It's killed more miners than monsters.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_chop.2: Chop and replant. That's how my wife did it.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_chop.3: That tree was older than you, boy.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_chop.5: Mountain wood. The best there is.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_farm.1: Farming takes patience. You have more than I do.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_farm.2: The soil doesn't lie. What you sow, you reap.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_farm.3: Your grandmother had a hand for plants.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_farm.5: Your own food. That way you depend on nobody.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_build.2: I raised the mountain house like that, stone by stone.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_build.3: Put the door facing east. Old habit.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_craft.1: Tools. Look after them and they'll look after you.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_craft.2: You make things with your hands. I like that.
dialog.dexrider.orga.see_craft.3: Takumi was good at this too.
dialog.dexrider.orga.learn.1: Hmph. I can %s now. Nothing to it.
dialog.dexrider.orga.learn.2: I can %s now. Not even this knee slows me down.
dialog.dexrider.orga.learn.3: I can %s now. Good teacher, boy.
dialog.dexrider.orga.learn.4: At my age, learning to %s. Who'd have thought.
dialog.dexrider.orga.learn.5: I can %s now. Don't tell anyone.
dialog.dexrider.orga.help.5: I'll lend you a hand. The good one.
dialog.dexrider.orga.job.4: Fine. I'll %s until you say otherwise.
dialog.dexrider.orga.job_stop.2: Hmph. Stopping. My knee thanks you.
dialog.dexrider.orga.job_stop.5: That's it. I'm sitting down for a while.
dialog.dexrider.orga.not_yet.1: I don't know how to %s. Teach me, boy.
dialog.dexrider.orga.not_yet.2: Hmph. I can't %s yet. Show me.
dialog.dexrider.orga.not_yet.3: At my age I learn slowly. Show me how to %s.
dialog.dexrider.orga.not_yet.5: First teach me to %s. Then we'll talk.

dialog.dexrider.orga.find.2: In fifty years I've seen few like it.
dialog.dexrider.orga.find.5: I'll store it. Don't waste it on nonsense.
dialog.dexrider.orga.full.1: Nowhere to put this. A chest, boy.
dialog.dexrider.orga.full.2: Hmph. Put a chest by the house.
dialog.dexrider.orga.full.4: My hands are full. A chest.

dialog.dexrider.nine.talk.1: Kagami-kun, how's it going? I'm still practicing Full Cowl... at 15%% I don't break anything anymore.
dialog.dexrider.nine.talk.2: Did you know All Might used to eat breakfast three times? Well, he eats healthier now.
dialog.dexrider.nine.talk.3: I've been writing your new cards in my notebook. Your deck is huge now!
dialog.dexrider.nine.talk.4: Sometimes I think about Kamino... thanks for trusting me with the Driver that day.
dialog.dexrider.nine.talk.5: Want to train later? I want to try Pegasus on something that moves fast.
dialog.dexrider.nine.talk.6: Kacchan says he doesn't care about your ranking. He checks it every day.
dialog.dexrider.nine.talk.7: Gouram brought me a leaf yesterday. I think it likes me.
dialog.dexrider.nine.talk.8: If you ever need to talk about your family stuff, I'm here, okay?
dialog.dexrider.cipher.talk.1: Did you eat? Your mother's going to ask me.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.talk.2: I checked the workshop. Someone touched the second drawer. Mei, probably.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.talk.3: Sleep. A tired Rider is a Rider who makes mistakes.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.talk.4: The Accel is still in its box. It stays there for a good while.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.talk.5: Isamu called. He says you're doing things right. I already knew.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.talk.6: Seven and back. Never forget it.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.talk.7: Your grandmother said tea should be drunk slowly. She was right about almost everything.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.talk.8: I'm proud of you, Yusuke. I don't say it much. I think it always.
dialog.dexrider.spore.talk.1: Kagami-kun, I found some beautiful mushrooms behind the house, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.talk.2: The spore network says there's a cat sleeping on the roof. Shh.
dialog.dexrider.spore.talk.3: Remember the forest at camp? It doesn't scare me anymore, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.talk.4: Itsuka says you should sleep more. I say so too.
dialog.dexrider.spore.talk.5: We planted mushrooms with Toru today. She dropped them all, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.talk.6: When it rains, the spores travel farther. I love the rain.
dialog.dexrider.spore.talk.7: Thanks for choosing me for the Driver. I still can't believe it, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.talk.8: Want some mushroom soup? I made it. It's... good. I think.
dialog.dexrider.forge.talk.1: Kagami-san, would you like some tea? I brought leaves from my parents' house.
dialog.dexrider.forge.talk.2: I've drafted a new version of the protocol. Only three pages this time.
dialog.dexrider.forge.talk.3: Studying the materials here helps me create better. It's fascinating.
dialog.dexrider.forge.talk.4: This week's report is concluded. Shall I read it to you?
dialog.dexrider.forge.talk.5: Sometimes it's hard for me to ask for help. You've taught me that it's fine.
dialog.dexrider.forge.talk.6: Jiro says I talk like a manual. Is that bad?
dialog.dexrider.forge.talk.7: The Forge form taught me that creating is also protecting.
dialog.dexrider.forge.talk.8: Thank you for trusting me, Kagami-san. I'll do my best to live up to it.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.talk.1: Kagami-kun! Can you see me? Of course you can! You're the only one!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.talk.2: I looked in the mirror with the armor on again today! I still can't believe it.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.talk.3: You know what? I'm not embarrassed anymore when people look around for me.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.talk.4: Let's get ice cream! My treat... well, your treat, I don't carry money.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.talk.5: Mina says we've been hanging out a lot lately. Ha ha! ...What do you think?
dialog.dexrider.mirage.talk.6: Describe my license photo again, please. I love hearing it!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.talk.7: I made a duplicate and left it in class! Aizawa didn't even notice.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.talk.8: Thanks for seeing me, Kagami-kun. Really. It means a lot.
dialog.dexrider.proto.talk.1: Kagami! My babies need a new name! How about 'Drillinator 9000'?
dialog.dexrider.proto.talk.2: I improved the Module Driver! Now it explodes 40%% less.
dialog.dexrider.proto.talk.3: Can I borrow the Jet Sliger? Just to look at it. Inside. With tools.
dialog.dexrider.proto.talk.4: Your dad put a third lock on the workshop! It's a challenge!
dialog.dexrider.proto.talk.5: Fourteen minutes as Proto and I didn't get tired. Because I didn't fight! I built!
dialog.dexrider.proto.talk.6: I have forty ideas and sixty-two sketches! Which one do I start with?
dialog.dexrider.proto.talk.7: The gray Rising cards are a beautiful mystery!
dialog.dexrider.proto.talk.8: Thanks for letting me be the tenth! My babies and I owe you one!
dialog.dexrider.warden.talk.1: Report: the perimeter is clear. You can relax a little, nephew.
dialog.dexrider.warden.talk.2: The Commission asks about you. I told them the minimum.
dialog.dexrider.warden.talk.3: Your father doesn't sleep well. Don't tell him I said so.
dialog.dexrider.warden.talk.4: You trained well today. Fix your left guard.
dialog.dexrider.warden.talk.5: Mei sent me fourteen messages. I'm not answering any of them yet.
dialog.dexrider.warden.talk.6: I signed Momo's protocol. It's better than the Commission's.
dialog.dexrider.warden.talk.7: Your mother sent me persimmons from Shizuoka. Three left. They're yours.
dialog.dexrider.warden.talk.8: I always knew about your father, you know. I'm glad he doesn't carry it alone anymore.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.talk.1: Sweetie! Did you eat well? I brought manju, they're in the kitchen.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.talk.2: I saved you a sheet of kitten stickers. Use them wherever you like.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.talk.3: Will you tell me about your friends? I like knowing you have people who love you.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.talk.4: Your dad was just as stubborn at your age. Well, he still is.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.talk.5: Ice cream on Saturday? No belt, like last time.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.talk.6: Sometimes I think about what Nezu said... It's not easy to change what you believe.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.talk.7: The mountain house has a workshop in the basement. Someday I'll show you.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.talk.8: It makes me so happy to really be your aunt, sweetie.
dialog.dexrider.orga.talk.1: Hmph. My knee says it's going to rain.
dialog.dexrider.orga.talk.2: Fifty years with the belt. And my grandson beats me. Good.
dialog.dexrider.orga.talk.3: Bring me tea. The good kind. Not that bagged stuff.
dialog.dexrider.orga.talk.4: Your grandmother would have known what to tell you. I only know how to fight.
dialog.dexrider.orga.talk.5: Nezu was right about something. Don't tell him.
dialog.dexrider.orga.talk.6: The card tones... keep practicing. They'll save your life.
dialog.dexrider.orga.talk.7: Takumi opened the bottle for me without a word. That boy...
dialog.dexrider.orga.talk.8: Hmph. I'm proud. There. Don't make me say it twice.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.talk.2: The Side Basshar is running fine. I checked it.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.talk.4: Nagisa asked me to talk to you more. I'm talking.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.talk.5: Dad trains less now. It's the knee.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.talk.6: The blueprints were in the second drawer. I never needed them.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.talk.7: Takumi designed it well. I just finished it.
