dialog.dexrider.nine.hello.1: Kagami-kun! Got a minute? I always have a minute for you.
dialog.dexrider.nine.hello.2: Hi! I was just going over my notes... what do we talk about?
dialog.dexrider.nine.topic_how.1: Good, really. My arms don't hurt after training anymore. Well, almost.
dialog.dexrider.nine.topic_how.2: A little nervous. Sir Nighteye looks at me like he already knows what I'll do.
dialog.dexrider.nine.topic_how.3: Great! All Might sent me a message with three exclamation marks.
dialog.dexrider.nine.topic_about.1: I didn't have a Quirk before, you know? I spent years filling notebooks about heroes. Now I fill notebooks about your cards.
dialog.dexrider.nine.topic_about.2: Nine feels strange to me: it's my form, but it was born from your Driver. Like you lent me a piece of your future.
dialog.dexrider.nine.topic_advice.1: When you don't know what to do, analyze first. But not so much that you arrive late.
dialog.dexrider.nine.topic_advice.2: Breaking your bones doesn't make you more of a hero. Take it from someone who broke them a lot.
dialog.dexrider.nine.topic_advice.3: Ask for help before you need it. It took me a while to learn that.
dialog.dexrider.nine.topic_deep.1: At Kamino, when you gave me the Driver, I thought if I failed I'd fail you too. And you still gave it to me without hesitating. Since that day I've been trying to deserve that trust. I never told you.
dialog.dexrider.nine.topic_secret.1: You know what scares me? That one day One For All asks for more than I can give and you're not there to say 'no' before. I learned your phrase. I repeat it when I train at 15%%... and I want to go higher.
dialog.dexrider.nine.gift_love.1: For me?! Kagami-kun, this is perfect! I'll take great care of it!
dialog.dexrider.nine.gift_love.2: My favorite! How did you know? Did you analyze me? Heh!
dialog.dexrider.nine.gift_love.3: Thank you, thank you! It's going on my 'best days' page.
dialog.dexrider.nine.gift_ok.1: Oh, thanks! I'll find a use for it, for sure.
dialog.dexrider.nine.gift_ok.3: Thanks! It makes me happy that you think of me.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.hello.2: Hmm. You look like you want to talk. Go on.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.topic_how.2: Better since I stopped keeping secrets at home.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.topic_how.3: Your mother made me sleep in the bed. So, fine.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.topic_about.1: I was a Commission agent inside Dai-Shocker. Seventeen years lying with my face. Now I fix engines. It's more honest.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.topic_about.2: I designed the Side Basshar at seventeen. Tetsuya finished it without the blueprints. He was always better than me with his hands.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.topic_advice.1: Measure twice, cut once. With parts and with people.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.topic_advice.2: Seven and back. With Overclock, with anger, with everything.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.topic_advice.3: If you can't tell something at home, think about why.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.topic_deep.1: Gunma wasn't your grandmother's fault, or just the leash. It was me, afraid. What I do know is that you said 'no' before, when I never said it. You didn't inherit that from me. That's yours.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.topic_secret.1: Your mother saved me twice. Once when she married me without knowing who I was. Again when she found out and stayed. I'm not telling you so you'll be grateful. I'm telling you so you know what to look for in someone.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.gift_love.1: Hmm. This is useful. Good eye.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.gift_love.2: Exactly what the workshop was missing. Thanks, son.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.gift_love.3: I'll keep it in the second drawer. Where nobody looks.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.gift_ok.2: Hmm. You didn't have to. But thanks.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.gift_ok.3: Fine. I'll leave it in the workshop.
dialog.dexrider.spore.hello.2: Hi, noko. The network told me you were coming.
dialog.dexrider.spore.topic_how.1: Good, noko. The garden mushrooms grew three centimeters.
dialog.dexrider.spore.topic_how.2: A little tired. I was feeling the forest all morning.
dialog.dexrider.spore.topic_how.3: Happy! Itsuka helped me with my history notes.
dialog.dexrider.spore.topic_about.1: My Quirk grows mushrooms wherever I want. It used to embarrass me. Now with Spore I feel everything the spores touch.
dialog.dexrider.spore.topic_about.2: I like small things, noko. What nobody looks at. A mushroom under a leaf keeps the whole forest working.
dialog.dexrider.spore.topic_advice.1: If you don't know where something is, stay still and listen. Sometimes the world tells you, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.topic_advice.2: Sleep. Seriously. Mushrooms grow at night, and so do you.
dialog.dexrider.spore.topic_advice.3: You don't always have to fight. Sometimes it's enough to find people in time.
dialog.dexrider.spore.topic_deep.1: The day you stopped being trustworthy to everyone, I stayed. It wasn't bravery, noko. I just knew you. And when you chose me for the Driver, I felt like someone finally saw what I saw in my Quirk.
dialog.dexrider.spore.topic_secret.1: In the camp forest I was really scared. I thought I wouldn't find anyone. Since I got the network, I dream that I find all thirteen in ten minutes. I wish it had been like that, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.gift_love.2: My favorite! I'll plant it... or eat it. Both!
dialog.dexrider.spore.gift_love.3: Thank you, thank you, noko! This makes me so happy.
dialog.dexrider.forge.hello.1: Kagami-san. How may I help you?
dialog.dexrider.forge.hello.2: Good day. I have a free moment, if you'd like to talk.
dialog.dexrider.forge.topic_how.1: Well, thank you. I slept seven hours, per protocol.
dialog.dexrider.forge.topic_how.2: A little worried about exams, but prepared.
dialog.dexrider.forge.topic_how.3: Very well. Today I created something useful on the first try.
dialog.dexrider.forge.topic_about.1: My Quirk creates objects from what I understand of their structure. That's why I study so much. Without knowledge, I can't create anything.
dialog.dexrider.forge.topic_about.2: As Forge, the scan shows me the formulas of what I look at. It was overwhelming. You shut it off at eleven minutes, and I'm grateful.
dialog.dexrider.forge.topic_advice.1: Prepare for the worst, but don't expect it.
dialog.dexrider.forge.topic_advice.2: Asking for help isn't weakness. It took me a while to understand.
dialog.dexrider.forge.topic_advice.3: A good plan has an exit. Always.
dialog.dexrider.forge.topic_deep.1: For a long time I doubted my decisions. I thought others chose better than me. When you asked for my consent for the Complete Form, I understood my opinion mattered. That's why I wrote a two-page protocol. It was my way of saying yes.
dialog.dexrider.forge.topic_secret.1: Sometimes, when I create something, I think about what I can't create: time, courage, friends. I found those in our class. And in you, Kagami-san.
dialog.dexrider.forge.gift_love.1: Oh! This is exactly to my liking. Thank you very much, Kagami-san.
dialog.dexrider.forge.gift_love.2: Such a fitting gift. I'll treasure it.
dialog.dexrider.forge.gift_love.3: My favorite! Forgive me, I got excited.
dialog.dexrider.forge.gift_ok.1: Thank you very much. That's very kind.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.hello.1: Kagami-kun! Were you looking for me? Of course you found me!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.hello.2: Hi, hi! What are we talking about today?
dialog.dexrider.mirage.topic_how.1: Super good! Today someone waved at me before I said anything. They saw the armor!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.topic_how.2: A little bored, that's why you came to save me!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.topic_how.3: Happy! Mina painted my nails. Well, I think so, I can't see them.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.topic_about.1: I've been invisible since I was born. Fourteen years without seeing myself in a mirror. As Mirage I saw myself for the first time. It wasn't my face... but someone was there.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.topic_about.2: I like making people laugh. If they can't see me, at least they can hear me laugh.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.topic_advice.1: If nobody sees you, make noise! And if they do, smile.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.topic_advice.2: Don't hide so much, Kagami-kun. Trust me, I know about that.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.topic_advice.3: A good flash at the right time beats ten punches.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.topic_deep.1: When you described my license photo, it was the first time someone told me how I look. I replay it in my head sometimes. Thanks for seeing what nobody else sees, Kagami-kun.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.topic_secret.1: You know? I used to think that if I really disappeared, nobody would notice. I don't think that anymore. You'd notice. And the whole class too. That's the best thing that ever happened to me.
dialog.dexrider.mirage.gift_love.1: For me?! It's beautiful! It shines like me!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.gift_love.2: My favorite! Kagami-kun, you're the best!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.gift_ok.2: Oh, a present! Thank you, thank you!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.gift_ok.3: I love it when you give me things! Thanks!
dialog.dexrider.proto.hello.1: Kagami! Here to see my babies? I have three new ones!
dialog.dexrider.proto.hello.2: Hi! Talk fast, the soldering iron is on.
dialog.dexrider.proto.topic_how.1: Great! I only blew up the workshop once today!
dialog.dexrider.proto.topic_how.2: Super inspired! I have forty ideas and not enough hours.
dialog.dexrider.proto.topic_how.3: A little frustrated. Your dad added another lock.
dialog.dexrider.proto.topic_about.1: My Quirk lets me see things up close. Details nobody notices. That's how I know where every screw goes.
dialog.dexrider.proto.topic_about.2: My babies are my life! Every invention is a step toward support heroes making the news too.
dialog.dexrider.proto.topic_advice.1: If something explodes, you were close to something big!
dialog.dexrider.proto.topic_advice.2: Prototype fast, fail fast, improve faster.
dialog.dexrider.proto.topic_advice.3: Listen to the user. Then ignore them a bit. Then listen again!
dialog.dexrider.proto.topic_deep.1: Everyone wanted the Driver to fight. I wanted it to understand it. When you lent it to me, I didn't fight: I built for fourteen minutes. It was the first time someone let me be a hero my way.
dialog.dexrider.proto.topic_secret.1: Sometimes I'm scared my babies will hurt someone. That's why I test so much. That's why I explode so much. I'd rather it blow up on me than on someone else. Don't tell anyone, okay?
dialog.dexrider.proto.gift_love.2: This goes straight into a new baby!
dialog.dexrider.proto.gift_love.3: My favorite! I'll put you in the invention's credits!
dialog.dexrider.proto.gift_ok.1: Thanks! I'll find a use for it.
dialog.dexrider.proto.gift_ok.2: Oh! Can it be taken apart? Thanks!
dialog.dexrider.proto.gift_ok.3: A gift! Into the parts box it goes.
dialog.dexrider.warden.hello.2: I have five minutes. They're yours.
dialog.dexrider.warden.topic_how.2: Better since your father and I started talking again.
dialog.dexrider.warden.topic_how.3: Fine. The Commission is calm, which worries me.
dialog.dexrider.warden.topic_about.1: I'm Warden because I stopped being Delta. I changed the name when I broke with the family. Same suit. Not the same me.
dialog.dexrider.warden.topic_about.2: I work for the Commission. Not because I believe in everything they do. Because someone has to watch from inside.
dialog.dexrider.warden.topic_advice.1: Check the exits before you go in.
dialog.dexrider.warden.topic_advice.2: Sign what you understand. Ask about the rest.
dialog.dexrider.warden.topic_advice.3: If someone offers you something in forty minutes, be suspicious.
dialog.dexrider.warden.topic_deep.1: I always knew about Gunma. I didn't say it for twenty years because I thought protecting your father meant keeping quiet. I was wrong. Silence is a leash too.
dialog.dexrider.warden.topic_secret.1: The first time I saw you on patrol, before I knew it was you, I thought: that kid's going to get into trouble. I investigated for months. When I found out, I felt pride before fear. That's not in any report.
dialog.dexrider.warden.gift_love.2: This wasn't in the budget. I'll accept it.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.hello.2: Hi, dear! Did you eat? Well, tell me.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.topic_how.1: Happy to see you! That already means I'm fine.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.topic_how.2: A little thoughtful. What Nezu said keeps going around in my head.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.topic_how.3: Good, sweetie. I made manju and they came out almost perfect.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.topic_about.1: They gave me the belt at sixteen. Nobody asked if I wanted it. I became Psyga because it was my turn.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.topic_about.2: Since I was fourteen I took care of the house, Dad and Tetsuya. I think that's why I love taking care of someone so much.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.topic_advice.1: Eat well. Sleep well. Everything else is easier to fix that way.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.topic_advice.2: Tell people you love them. You never know when it's the last time.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.topic_advice.3: A kitten sticker fixes any bad day.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.topic_deep.1: When Mom died, Dad said she brought Takumi back. I always believed it. Lately I feel there's something I don't know... and I'm scared to ask. Is it strange to want the truth and not want it at the same time?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.topic_secret.1: I never had children. Sometimes I thought I didn't need them. But when I see you, sweetie, I understand what I missed. Thank you for letting me really be your aunt.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.gift_love.1: Oh, sweetie! It's just what I like!
dialog.dexrider.psyga.gift_love.2: You're so thoughtful! Just like your grandmother.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.gift_love.3: My favorite! I'm giving you a huge hug.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.gift_ok.2: For me! You didn't have to, sweetie.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.gift_ok.3: I'll keep it close. Thank you.
dialog.dexrider.orga.hello.1: Hmph. Boy. Sit. My knee won't let me stand.
dialog.dexrider.orga.hello.2: Talk. I have time. At my age, it's the only thing left over.
dialog.dexrider.orga.topic_how.2: The knee says it's going to rain. Other than that, fine.
dialog.dexrider.orga.topic_how.3: Better since I drink tea with my children again.
dialog.dexrider.orga.topic_about.1: Fifty years with the belt. Orga. Second generation. I learned to read card tones before I learned to read love letters.
dialog.dexrider.orga.topic_about.2: I raised the mountain house stone by stone. Your grandmother planted the garden. She made it a home.
dialog.dexrider.orga.topic_advice.1: Listen to the tones. A card always warns before it strikes.
dialog.dexrider.orga.topic_advice.2: Don't fight like me. Say no in time.
dialog.dexrider.orga.topic_advice.3: What you break, you repair. Things and people.
dialog.dexrider.orga.topic_deep.1: I sent Takumi to Gunma. It cost me two sons. Nezu made me see it with one question. I've spent weeks wondering what else I haven't wanted to see.
dialog.dexrider.orga.topic_secret.1: Whoever taught me to read the tones wasn't family. If they're still alive, they know every card there is. If you ever find them, boy, don't be brave. Run. And call Isamu.
dialog.dexrider.orga.gift_love.2: The good kind. Your grandmother would have approved.
dialog.dexrider.orga.gift_love.3: I'm keeping it. Don't tell Nagisa, she'll eat it.
dialog.dexrider.orga.gift_ok.2: You didn't have to. But fine.
dialog.dexrider.orga.gift_ok.3: I'll leave it on the table.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.hello.2: I have a part half done. But go ahead.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.topic_about.1: Kaixa. I'm the youngest. I follow Dad. I finish what others start.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.topic_about.2: I finished the Side Basshar without blueprints. The blueprints were in the second drawer. I never looked.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.topic_advice.2: If you don't know, watch how someone else does it.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.topic_deep.1: Dad taught me to read the tones. Nobody else. I thought it was because I was special. Now I think it's because I never asked anything.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.topic_secret.1: Sometimes I want to talk to Takumi more. I don't know how to start. He designed what I finished. Maybe that's already a conversation.
message.dexrider.gift_empty: Hold what you want to give them.
screen.dexrider.ally_talk.gift.tip: Gives them what you hold in your main hand. Each one has favorites.
dialog.dexrider.nine.sleep.1: I'll go over my hero notes... five minutes and then I'll sleep.
dialog.dexrider.nine.sleep.2: Good night. I'm training early tomorrow.
dialog.dexrider.nine.wake.1: Good morning! I slept like a rock. Shall we go on patrol?
dialog.dexrider.nine.wake.2: I'm up. I'm giving it a hundred percent today!
dialog.dexrider.forge.sleep.1: Time to rest. A good sleep routine is part of training.
dialog.dexrider.forge.sleep.2: Good night. I left everything tidy for tomorrow.
dialog.dexrider.forge.wake.1: Good morning. I've already made a list of what needs doing today.
dialog.dexrider.forge.wake.2: Good morning. Shall I make some tea to start?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.sleep.1: Good night, everyone. Bundle up, it's getting cold.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.sleep.2: I'm off to bed. If anyone has a nightmare, you know where I am.
dialog.dexrider.psyga.wake.1: Good morning. Eat something before you head out, okay?
dialog.dexrider.psyga.wake.2: Good morning. I slept really well. How about you?
dialog.dexrider.cipher.sleep.1: Closing out the day. I'll check the cartridges tomorrow.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.sleep.2: Good night. Seven hours and I'm back.
dialog.dexrider.cipher.wake.2: Morning. I ran the perimeter in my head: all quiet.
dialog.dexrider.warden.sleep.1: Rest shift. If you hear anything odd, wake me.
dialog.dexrider.warden.sleep.2: Good night. I sleep with one eye open, just in case.
dialog.dexrider.warden.wake.2: On my feet. The Commission doesn't wait.
dialog.dexrider.orga.sleep.1: Off to bed. At my age, a bed is a luxury you respect.
dialog.dexrider.orga.sleep.2: Good night. The house is in good hands.
dialog.dexrider.orga.wake.1: Good morning. Someone put the water on for tea.
dialog.dexrider.orga.wake.2: The sun's up. Come on, the day won't work itself.
dialog.dexrider.spore.sleep.1: The mushrooms glow at night... I'll fall asleep watching them, noko.
dialog.dexrider.spore.sleep.2: Good night, noko. Dream of mushrooms.
dialog.dexrider.spore.wake.1: Good morning, noko! There's dew on the mushrooms.
dialog.dexrider.spore.wake.2: I'm awake, noko. Want to see what grew overnight?
dialog.dexrider.mirage.sleep.1: Good night! Even if no one sees me sleep, I still tuck in nicely!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.sleep.2: Going to bed. Don't look for me, I'm invisible!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.wake.1: Good morning! Can you see me yet? Oh, right, you can't!
dialog.dexrider.mirage.wake.2: Up and at 'em! Today's gonna be awesome!
dialog.dexrider.proto.sleep.1: My babies stay charging all night. Good night.
dialog.dexrider.proto.sleep.2: Sleeping for a bit... and dreaming of new thrusters!
dialog.dexrider.proto.wake.1: Good morning! I came up with an invention in my sleep!
dialog.dexrider.proto.wake.2: Up! My babies have a full battery.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.sleep.2: Going to bed. I'll get back to my stuff tomorrow.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.wake.1: ...Morning. I haven't had anything yet, don't talk to me much.
dialog.dexrider.kaixa.wake.2: Awake. Is the tea ready, Dad?
moment.dexrider.tea.1: Dad, I brought you tea. Not too sweet, the way you like it.
moment.dexrider.tea.1.r: Thank you, Nagisa. Sit with me a while.
moment.dexrider.tea.2: Dad, remember when you'd make tea for the four of us after training?
moment.dexrider.tea.2.r: Of course. Tetsuya always burned his tongue.
moment.dexrider.parts.1: Mr. Modular Driver! Can I see how the cartridge fits? Just looking, I promise!
moment.dexrider.parts.1.r: Looking, Hatsume. Looking. Not taking apart.
moment.dexrider.parts.2: I made you a new holder for your cartridges! Isn't my baby gorgeous?
moment.dexrider.mushrooms.1: Toru, look! This mushroom really glows, noko.
moment.dexrider.mushrooms.1.r: So cute! Almost as cute as me! Can I touch it?
moment.dexrider.mushrooms.2: Toru, help me count the mushrooms in the garden, noko.
moment.dexrider.mushrooms.2.r: Twenty-three! No, wait... I counted myself!
moment.dexrider.study.1: Yaoyorozu-san, could you help me with this exercise? I don't get part three.
moment.dexrider.study.1.r: Of course, Midoriya-san. Look, start here.
moment.dexrider.study.2: Yaoyorozu-san, I wrote down everything we saw in today's fights. Shall we go over it?
moment.dexrider.study.2.r: Good idea, Midoriya-san. I'll bring my notes, all sorted.
moment.dexrider.brothers.1.r: Anytime, Takumi. But I'm not letting you win this time.
moment.dexrider.brothers.2: Isamu, did you check your badge? It's scratched.
moment.dexrider.brothers.2.r: From the last fight. I'm leaving it, gives it character.
moment.dexrider.siblings.1: Tetsu, did you eat anything today? Don't lie to me.
moment.dexrider.siblings.1.r: Yes, Nee-san... a little. Okay, almost nothing.
moment.dexrider.siblings.2: Tetsu, I fixed your jacket. It had a hole in the elbow.
moment.dexrider.father.1: Tetsuya, come here. It's been a while since we talked, just us two.
moment.dexrider.father.1.r: ...Fine, Dad. But only for a bit.
moment.dexrider.father.2: Tetsuya, you fought well today. I'm proud of you.
moment.dexrider.father.2.r: It's not a big deal, Dad. ...But thanks.
moment.dexrider.training.1: Hagakure-san! Want to practice dodging? Try not to let me find you.
moment.dexrider.training.1.r: You're on! Let's see if you can spot me, Midoriya!
moment.dexrider.training.2: Hagakure-san, you moved really well in that fight today.
moment.dexrider.training.2.r: Thanks! Even if nobody saw it, hehe!
moment.dexrider.workshop.1: Tetsuya-san! Your weapon needs a new sight! Let me fit one!

screen.dexrider.ally_menu.chore.fish: Fishes in the water closest to their house and stores the catch in the chest. Also: hand them a fishing rod.
screen.dexrider.ally_menu.chore.breed: Pairs up animals using the food in the chest (up to 10 per species). Also: hand them a lead.
screen.dexrider.ally_menu.chore.smelt: Runs the furnaces, smokers and blast furnaces within 6 blocks of their house: loads what's in the chest, adds fuel and stores the output. Also: hand them a furnace.
screen.dexrider.ally_menu.chore.guard: Patrols around their house at night and spots monsters from farther away (doesn't sleep). Also: hand them a sword.
message.dexrider.ally_no_water: %s can't find any water near their house to fish in.
screen.dexrider.ally_menu.plan_copy.tip: Memorizes what's inside the marked area (up to 12×12×12 and 600 blocks). The area is cleared afterwards.
screen.dexrider.ally_menu.build.tip: Then Shift + right-click a block: the copy starts on top of it (that's the corner). Uses the materials in their house chest.
message.dexrider.ally_plan_nozone: %s needs an area marked around what you want copied (Shift + right-click two corners with a pickaxe).
message.dexrider.ally_plan_big: That's too big for %s: at most %3$s blocks per side and %4$s blocks in total.
message.dexrider.ally_plan_empty: %s doesn't see anything to copy in that area.
message.dexrider.ally_plan_ok: %s memorized the blueprint: %s blocks. Press Build to choose where to put the copy.
message.dexrider.ally_plan_none: %s doesn't have a blueprint yet: mark an area and press Copy blueprint.
message.dexrider.ally_build_pick: Shift + right-click a block: %s will build the copy on top of it (that's the corner).
message.dexrider.ally_build_missing: %s needs %s in their house chest to keep building.
